cohort_total_n_excerpt: The primary analysis included 34,887 men who were randomly assigned to 1 of 4 treatment groups: 8752 to receive selenium; 8737, vitamin E; 8702, both agents, and 8696, placebo.
reason: The trial evaluated overall incident prostate cancer among men without prostate cancer at enrollment. The abstract does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint. The total case count is the sum of the four explicitly reported treatment-arm counts.
